inference_before_unblinding: No global method winner can be assigned from sparse frames. Several Sully candidates preserve both coarse character features and the vest this seed, unlike the single such character-bearing candidate observed at seed 31; the one-seed wardrobe signal should not become a universal ranking boost. Action count and ending remain separate failure dimensions. Series30 candidates form a close large cluster with several more distinct pose/lighting/depiction cases; more face-visible frames must not be mistaken for proof of superior identity.
